term: original causal power in a designated respect
definition: At the world considered, an existing bearer has intrinsic power and receives none through the modeled power-transmission relation. This does not imply that its existence is uncaused, modally necessary, or devoid of composition.
note: This is an analytic control for BR-POWER-TO-BEING (#319). It makes the respect restriction explicit and never equates unborrowed exercise with uncaused esse.
